data.name: Niverium
data.detailed_description:
About the game

About the game Niverium is a survival game in a harsh world where you have to take on the role of a man sent to the very bottom. You will have to do any dirty work for those who stand above you, under threat of death. In this dangerous world, you need to be doubly careful and make decisions, each of which can be both a salvation and the cause of your death.

At the very bottom

You start in a huge underground city, the last refuge for humanity. In Niverium, you were thrown into the lowest stratum of society. Now you don't have a name, just a number that identifies you. You belong to the heads of state and will have to negotiate, threaten, kill and steal according to their instructions. Disobedience will lead to certain death.

Actions

You can influence the fate of heroes, factions, and small associations. The outcome of any assignment is in your hands, and under certain conditions you will be able to make your own decisions.

Survival

In this ruthless world, time becomes even more cruel. Every day you live will be counted, and you need to decide how to spend it. Any resource can run out at any moment and in any circumstances, which can be the end for you.
